about_short_description.short_description: Capital Bank Group offers the Jordanian market a comprehensive set of commercial and investment banking services and solutions

product.name: Corporate Banking Services
product.description: Banking solutions tailored for small, medium, large, and government companies to manage their financial operations efficiently.

product.name: Investment Banking and Asset Management
product.description: Services for managing assets, investment portfolios, and providing financial advisory to individuals and institutions.

product.name: Credit and Financing Solutions
product.description: Various loan products including personal, housing, car, commercial, and export financing to support liquidity and growth.

product.name: Payment and Card Services
product.description: Credit and debit card products including Visa Infinite, Signature, and Platinum cards with various cashback and reward programs.

product.name: Digital and Mobile Banking Services
product.description: Online and mobile banking platforms for account management, transfers, bill payments, and loan applications.

identifier.value: International and Local Money Transfer Services

product.name: International and Local Money Transfer Services
product.description: Services enabling fast and secure domestic and international money transfers in multiple currencies.
